rules: Original adult fashion dolls with visibly molded plastic, joints and synthetic hair.
Keep the molded expression fixed in the reference image. Use a new image from the next cut for a different expression.
Miniature 1:6 sets with a clear middle and foreground edge. Use a set loop on layered shots when available.

yellowbirds.lettering_style: bold varsity letters across the chest

style: One distinct stock synthetic voice per doll.
Short fades at both edges of each line.

targets.name: Tom's YouTube Shorts channel
targets.owner_note: Tom will create and own the channel. The channel focuses on local LLMs and local AI. Use the synthetic-content setting and an AI-generated label in the description.
